advisories.reason: Pulled in by Expo CLI/Metro build tooling (micromatch); only processes our own glob patterns at build time, never user input. Revisit on each Expo SDK upgrade.
Pulled in by @expo/config-plugins for build-time code signing helpers; not shipped in the app bundle and not used to verify untrusted signatures. Revisit on each Expo SDK upgrade.

Moderate. Pulled in by expo-router (query-string 7 pins 0.2.x; the patched 0.4+ is ESM-only and breaks it). Worst case a crafted deep link hangs the app of the person who opens it: no data exposure. Revisit on each Expo SDK upgrade.

Moderate. Pulled in by xcode (Expo config plugins) at build time only, never in the app bundle; the bug is in v3/v5/v6 with a caller buffer, which xcode does not use. Revisit on each Expo SDK upgrade.
